# Learned instinct: secrets-no-tfstate-in-git (confidence 1)

Terraform state files (`.tfstate`, `.tfstate.backup`) must never be committed to source control. State files contain plaintext values of all managed resource attributes including secrets. Use remote state (S3 + DynamoDB lock, GitLab Terraform state backend, or Terraform Cloud). Add `*.tfstate` and `*.tfstate.backup` to `.gitignore`.

Source: HashiCorp Terraform best practices; OWASP IaC Security
